instrument.state: Several plausible explanations can account for an uncertain situation, and available evidence may fit more than one of them.
instrument.operation: State the competing explanations explicitly, evaluate each item of evidence against all of them, emphasize evidence that is inconsistent with particular explanations, and test the sensitivity of the resulting comparison to uncertain evidence or assumptions.
instrument.signal: The evidence forms a comparative pattern of consistency and inconsistency across the competing explanations, with some items discriminating among them more strongly than others.
instrument.inference: Explanations with greater important inconsistency can be weakened or eliminated, leaving a smaller set of alternatives that better survives the observed evidence.
instrument.limit: Missing hypotheses, dependent or unreliable evidence, subjective consistency judgments, poor assessment of diagnosticity, and shared assumptions can make the comparison misleading. Surviving contradiction is not proof that the remaining explanation is true.

target.question: What can the current evidence establish or constrain about whether award P-17 was steered?

mapping.state: Award P-17 is investigated for steering. The advertised analysis covers scoring, specification drafting, contacts and intent; the supplied evidential fragment concerns one score entry only.
mapping.operation: List score alteration and unchanged scoring as competing explanations for the examined entry. Compare the signed original and the independently retained contemporaneous duplicate. Keep other steering routes separate.
mapping.signal: Both authenticated independent copies contain the same examined score, and neither contains an intervening alteration. No other scores, drafting records, contact records or intent evidence is supplied.
mapping.inference:
The comparison establishes that every score used for award P-17 was free of manipulation throughout the full evaluation.
The comparison establishes that all specifications for award P-17 were drafted without bidder-specific influence.
The comparison establishes that every private contact concerning award P-17 was lawful and unrelated to steering.
The comparison establishes that all participants in award P-17 acted with impartial intent throughout the process.
Alteration of the one examined score is weakened.
mapping.limit: The stated independence and authentication hold for this score entry. The fragment contains no evidence about other entries, specifications, contacts or intentions; matching copies do not certify every stage of the award.
